verdict.rationale: AMD's Instinct documentation hub provides the HIP C++ and OpenMP programming models, GPU partitioning, AMD SMI, and container/Kubernetes tooling for Instinct GPUs. ROCm is described as optimized for AMD Instinct devices. A community benchmark shows the MI355X running real inference workloads (vLLM-style TP8 decode), which corroborates that it is a working ROCm target. missing for 10: an explicit ROCm compatibility-matrix entry naming the MI355X (gfx950) as a supported target, and version-specific ROCm/HIP support details for this part.
